title: The Cutting Edge: Week of August 30th
body:
**Highlights**
- The pre-partnership [AMA with Anmol Network](https://t.me/heyedgeware/53871), the project founded by Furqan Ahmed (an Edgeware Builder Guild member) got a colossal response from the community. Furqan is interested in a community directed proposal for Anmol airdrop to $EDG holders. 
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-dev-digest-aug-29/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [Kylin DDM/Os](https://twitter.com/Kylin_Network/status/1433513566787805184?s=20) are coming to Edgeware.
- [Snapshot is now live](https://blog.commonwealth.im/snapshot-is-now-live-on-common-protocol/) on Common Protocol.
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Common Protocol partners with [Alpha Finance](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1432706535302574085?s=20) and [Near Protocol](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1433442777740754946?s=20).


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1100-erup-4-substrate-30-evm-updates-runtime-modules)


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
- Recent/trending Community Research thread(s):
- [SimpleMajority - a proposed Edgeware governance standard](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/
